en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ahmad Bin Al Nazar, from Amro Bin Shimr, from Jabir, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘There is no one except there is for him vigour and calmness. So the one who was such that his calmness leads him to a Sunnah, so he has been guided, and the one who was such that his calmness leads him to an innovation, so he has deviated’.
en.sarwar: 10. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Ahmad ibn al-Nadr from ‘Amr ibn Shimr from Jabir from abu Ja’far (a.s.) who has said the following. “

There is no one without excitement and calmness. Whoever’s calmness would lead him towards the Sunnah, noble traditions of the holy prophet (s.a.), he is rightly guided but if it would lead him towards innovations then he has gone astray.”
